notes.title: Big or small
notes.notes:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41592613/d348fd5e5d7f7f3900442bccb06d1a6ab5ad66c7.jpg[/img]

Did you know that some ducks always wanted to be tiny, some always wanted to be huge? Nothing wrong to remain natural, at the usual size, but toys can now be scaled up or down! Just go to the build page and try it.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41592613/121e656231210bb3abae4c5ef8461fba7168d74f.jpg[/img]

Big magnets are stronger, tiny pirate boats shoot tiny cannonballs, large volleyballs are way bigger than small foxes (but they don't mind), big bombs, huge bombs, everything happens in your bath tub!

Small change, big fun :D

notes.title: Bathtime Toys is OUT NOW!
notes.notes:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41592613/55607e1d8a12daac785e1e45326f5423667d80c8.png[/img]

We've just launched Bathtime Toys, a creative playground for kids. Assemble 3d puzzle toys, and play with them in your decorated bathtub. No hard rules to win or lose.

Grab it with a [b]-20% discount[/b], and join our [b]live launch party from 20:00 (UTC+2)[/b].

https://store.steampowered.com/app/1831580/Bathtime_Toys/

At the party, my kids are going to fool around with the toys, we'll have some drinks, snacks, and we'll casually celebrate the event! It will mean a great deal to us if you can join our live broadcast on the game's Steam page.

The game is also available on Itch.io and on Google Play for Android.
For more details, check the game's website, and our Discord:
https://www.lasttales.com/bathtimetoys/
https://discord.gg/gdUbBhj

Have a great time!
Alex

notes.title: Bathtime Toys DEMO NOW
notes.notes:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41592613/b9b0ab4d248bcb5fd7f6d33c5b1010a9fc159eca.jpg[/img]

Hi everyone,

[h3]Bathtime Toys DEMO is OUT![/h3]
It's a creative playground for kids, where you assemble simple, but cute 3d puzzle toys to play with. Express yourself by coloring them, and decorate your bathtub. No hard rules to win or lose.

Grab the [b]FREE DEMO NOW[/b], and try it until the end of the Steam Next Fest, on 28 February.

[h3]Welcome to Steam Next Fest![/h3]
On [b]22 February 20:00 (UTC+2)[/b] we're playing Bathtime Toys live, so join us, and see what the kids are up to this time! We're gonna build some toys, decorate the bathtub, and invent some funny challenges.

[h3]THE FULL GAME[/h3]
If you feel inspired, [b]WISHLIST [/b]the game, and be ready for the [b]FULL RELEASE on 3 March[/b]!
It will also be available on Google Play for Android phones and tablets.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41592613/969fde23dc61f9aaabb529d3405b2a464eb654cd.jpg[/img]

For more info, join Last Tales Discord server:

Have fun!
Alex
